methodology: Articles sourced from Virginia-specific RSS feeds and Google News RSS, filtered for AI/technology/workforce relevance, then assessed by Claude against the scenario framework. Each article is tagged with the region it most affects and the scenario it signals toward.

signals.title: New partnership between VCU and AI Ready RVA aims to boost AI education, innovation and community impact - VCU News
signals.signal_reading: VCU's partnership with AI Ready RVA signals intentional knowledge distribution infrastructure beyond the university, creating pathways for peer-to-peer learning and community-rooted AI capability building rather than just elite institutional concentration.

signals.title: RC-RV partners with ed2go to launch innovative, on-demand workforce training programs - Roanoke College
signals.signal_reading: On-demand workforce training via ed2go platform extends AI-adjacent skills to underserved regions, but the pre-packaged delivery model suggests shallow, consumption-oriented adoption rather than deep capability development or local innovation capacity.

signals.title: Amid AI, Quantum Tech, Chesterfield County, Va., Invests in Cyber - govtech.com
signals.signal_reading: Chesterfield County's investment in cybersecurity amid AI and quantum threats demonstrates deepening technical sophistication in select jurisdictions with resources, while counties lacking IT capacity fall further behind in protecting critical infrastructure.

signals.title: Compass Datacenters pulls out of Digital Gateway AI data center project - qz.com
signals.signal_reading: Data center investment withdrawal signals market volatility and community resistance that could slow AI infrastructure buildout, potentially creating neither the distributed access nor concentrated excellence if capital and political will fragment.

signals.title: AI pressure grows on Richmond's young workforce - Axios
signals.signal_reading: Richmond's young workforce facing AI pressure reveals metro areas grappling with capability requirements while smaller markets lack even this pressure signal—concentration of both threat and opportunity in urban centers deepens the metro-rural divide.
